page.overview:
Who is Todd Marcus?

Todd Marcus is a minor character in Cars and Cars 3. He is a red and black Axxelo/Fission. He races for the sponsor "No Stall." He was born and raised in Dieselton, Alabama.

"Todd Marcus is known as the biggest race car to emerge from his hometown of Dieselton, Alabama. He's also known as the only race car to emerge from Dieselton, Alabama. When asked why he chose to be car number 123, he simply replied, "Because it's easy to remember." That's why it's also his ATM number, his internet login, his home security code, and his safe combination."

Todd Marcus appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Masterson. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 13th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 13th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 13th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 13th place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 13th place.

Todd Marcus is the first character unlocked in Cars: Fast as Lightning.
